values.user_data:
#!/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail

dnf install -y openssh-server
id oracle-tunnel >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --create-home --shell /sbin/nologin oracle-tunnel

install -d -o oracle-tunnel -g oracle-tunnel -m 0700 /home/oracle-tunnel/.ssh
cat > /home/oracle-tunnel/.ssh/authorized_keys <<'AUTHORIZED_KEYS'
restrict,port-forwarding,permitlisten="10.60.1.10:11521" ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIOSMkesr7B6vclthpkmDWqKfLzhAfloTz6XCVhkgafD9 oracle-dms-reverse-tunnel
AUTHORIZED_KEYS
chown oracle-tunnel:oracle-tunnel /home/oracle-tunnel/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 0600 /home/oracle-tunnel/.ssh/authorized_keys

cat > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/90-oracle-dms-tunnel.conf <<'SSHD'
PasswordAuthentication no
PermitRootLogin no
PubkeyAuthentication yes
GatewayPorts clientspecified
AllowUsers oracle-tunnel
AllowTcpForwarding remote
PermitListen 10.60.1.10:11521
PermitTTY no
X11Forwarding no
AllowAgentForwarding no
MaxSessions 0
SSHD

sshd -t
systemctl enable --now sshd
systemctl enable --now amazon-ssm-agent || true

create_dms_endpoints.description: Create DMS source and target endpoints only after the Oracle secret is populated and the tunnel is tested.

create_dms_task.description: Create (but do not start) the Full Load + CDC task after endpoints and target schema are ready.

dms_allocated_storage.description: DMS replication instance storage in GiB.

dms_multi_az.description: Use a Multi-AZ DMS replication instance. Disabled by default as a migration development cost tradeoff.

dms_replication_instance_class.description: AWS DMS replication instance class. Size after endpoint tests and throughput review.

enable_nat_gateway.description: Optional NAT Gateway for private-subnet public internet egress. Not required by the base DMS design because S3 and Secrets Manager use VPC endpoints.

enable_schema_conversion_project.description: Create the serverless DMS Schema Conversion project after both endpoint secrets and network connectivity are ready.

manage_dms_cloudwatch_logs_role.description: Create the account-level dms-cloudwatch-logs-role. Set false only if an equivalent role already exists and is correctly configured.

manage_dms_vpc_role.description: Create the account-level dms-vpc-role. Set false only if an equivalent role already exists and is correctly configured.

notification_email.description: Optional email address for CloudWatch alarm notifications. Leave empty to create the SNS topic without a subscription.

oracle_source_cidr.description: Current public egress IPv4 CIDR of the Oracle RHEL VM, normally /32. Reconfirm immediately before apply.

postgres_backup_retention_days.description: RDS automated backup retention in days.

postgres_database_name.description: Initial PostgreSQL database name for the Oracle migration.

postgres_deletion_protection.description: Protect the RDS target against accidental deletion.

postgres_engine_version.description: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL engine version. Verify it is orderable in this account and Region before apply.

postgres_instance_class.description: Amazon RDS instance class. Verify orderability for PostgreSQL 18.6 and Multi-AZ in us-east-1 before apply.

postgres_master_username.description: RDS-managed master username. Create separate least-privilege DMS/application users after deployment.

postgres_max_allocated_storage.description: Maximum autoscaled RDS storage in GiB.

postgres_multi_az.description: Deploy the RDS PostgreSQL DB instance with a Multi-AZ standby.

private_subnet_cidrs.description: Private subnet CIDRs keyed by az_a and az_b.

project_name.description: Project identifier used in AWS resource names and tags.

public_subnet_cidrs.description: Public subnet CIDRs keyed by az_a and az_b.

single_nat_gateway.description: When NAT is enabled, use one NAT Gateway across both AZs for lower development cost; false creates one NAT Gateway per AZ.

source_oracle_database_name.description: Oracle PDB service/database identifier used by the DMS Schema Conversion data provider.

source_oracle_service_name.description: Oracle PDB service name used by the DMS source endpoint.

source_schemas.description: Oracle application schemas included by the DMS table-mapping selection rules.

tunnel_gateway_private_ip.description: Fixed private IP for the EC2 reverse-tunnel gateway in public subnet az_a.

tunnel_instance_type.description: EC2 instance class for the lightweight SSH tunnel gateway.

tunnel_listen_port.description: Private VPC TCP port on which the gateway accepts the reverse-tunnel stream from DMS.

tunnel_public_key.description: OpenSSH public key for the restricted oracle-tunnel account. Never provide the private key.

vpc_cidr.description: Dedicated migration VPC CIDR. Confirm it does not overlap any existing or connected networks.
